existing_proofs_preserved: Complete masked row load/conversion, squared reduction, reciprocal sqrt, scaling and store are proved with independent full-row formula when N<=B, termination and frame. Four floating storage profiles preserve explicit fp32 loads/runtime epsilon and destination casts. The candidate changes only pointer-index multiplication order and needs no numeric rewrite assumption.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Entire one-pass row body is represented, including padding and source 1/sqrt order.
Reshape, conditional contiguous copy, size-dependent limit/error, device scope, grid and reshape-back are uncomposed.

dtype_review: Storage supports fp16,bf16,fp32,fp64. Python accepts x without a dtype guard, converts loaded x to fp32 and inherits x dtype in y. Other supported storage conversions or precise rejection cases are outside the four-case formal API.
branch_review: The formal N<=B condition is a valid successful-path boundary, matching the explicit host N>BLOCK_N RuntimeError. What is missing is the wrapper proof connecting that rejection, MAX_FUSED_SIZE dependent on element_size, contiguous branch and output reshape; no execution on rejected sizes is demanded.

structural_gaps.finding: The host reshapes, conditionally copies, chooses min(65536/element_size,next_power_of_2(N)), rejects excess width and reshapes the returned buffer.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The row theorem does not establish this complete transformation or its actual failure branch.

structural_gaps.finding: The source has fp32 conversion and pointer-dependent output storage, but Storage enumerates only four types.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Additional admitted routes or explicit admission/rejection mapping are required; they cannot be inferred from fp32 arithmetic assumptions.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Fp32 reduction, runtime epsilon conversion, sqrt/division and represented storage casts can be explicitly deferred at their exact profiles. No rsqrt rewrite is silently substituted for 1/sqrt.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
